subject: Sync command JSON files and docs with 1.3.0 behavior (#1549)
reason: The change edits only documentation markdown (docs/commands/*.md) and command-metadata JSON files (src/commands/*.json). Those JSON files are not compiled into the module, not read at runtime, and not consumed by any build rule, script, or test in the repository; command registration happens in src/module_loader.cc via vmsdk::module::Options (names, flags, ACLs), which is unchanged, and the module never calls ValkeyModule_SetCommandInfo. The parsers for the documented options (ADDSCORES, SCORER, LOAD ... AS, the FT.HYBRID KNN block) are untouched — the commit merely syncs docs/metadata to beha
